name: intercity_high_speed_maglev
description: The source describes intercity high-speed maglev without eligible urban-rail mode proof.

candidates.title: Intercity high-speed maglev completes corridor test
candidates.search_snippet: An intercity high-speed maglev completed a corridor test.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic high-speed railway release. An intercity high-speed maglev completed a test on a long-distance corridor between regions. The source establishes intercity service and does not establish Metro, MRT, Subway, Light Rail, Tram, AGT, Monorail, People Mover, or Urban Rail mode.

contract_notes: Maglev alone is not Scope proof; intercity/high-speed service remains out of scope.
